retired.marker: RETIRED — NOT PRESENT IN CURRENT CONSTITUTION
retired.reason: Force-majeure termination trigger (60 days). The Constitution states no force-majeure position: §31.14-C names force majeure only as one of six circumstances permitting shorter notice, and fixes no period.
retired.ruling: owner, 2026-09-14: 'The eight standards that are not defined in the current approved Constitution must be retired … Do not use them in active LegalMind reviews. Do not show them as approved standards. Preserve their historical/reference record.' The set is seven, not eight — see the AM-59 r5 correction in AM-65.
retired.note: The file is kept, and `ratified` is left as it was: this standard WAS ratified from a LeapSwitch document on that date, and the historical Findings that cite it stay readable (rule 17). _legal_rule_note: APPROVED ZERO-TOLERANCE LEGAL RULE (manager ruling 2026-08-19; owner
approval to wire, 2026-08-20). MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE (no decision needed);
ANY deviation -- unlimited included -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal Decision
required; nothing that differs is ever auto-approved. There are
deliberately NO thresholds and NO tolerance bands: do not add
acceptable_max or approval_required_above, and do not ask for them --
the policy is that none exists. Wired as deviation_outcome +
unlimited_outcome, both read by the evaluators; an unrecognised value
fails closed to NOT_APPLICABLE and a human (ENG-09, Step 20 r4).
